_comment: The words of the AI section in Settings: the player's own AI (a text provider, and ComfyUI for pictures) and its
Test buttons. What the AI is asked is not here: it is the mods' ai/prompts.json. A label is said one way (the
first line of its pool). {name} is a value the game fills in.

lines.settings.ai.note: Your own AI can write what the rivals say, the street talk, the paper's stories and the dealers' word on a car. The game never waits for it: its own words are always there, and what the AI writes is kept in the save.
lines.settings.ai.enabled: Use my AI for what people say and write
lines.settings.ai.key.hint: kept encrypted for this Windows user
lines.settings.ai.key.saved: A key is saved, encrypted. Type a new one to change it.
lines.settings.ai.comfy: Paint new rivals' portraits with ComfyUI
